guards.what: FOUR-VERB COVERAGE (enchant / upgrade+downgrade / transform / copy) -- stated explicitly so the hole cannot reopen silently. Verb 3, TRANSFORM: CardCmd.Transform (CardCmd.cs:369-451) removes the original from its pile and adds a freshly-built replacement; it never touches Enchantment, and the destroyed original takes its enchantment with it
guards.maps_to: TRANSFORM verdict: FAITHFUL, both engines drop the enchantment. C#: CardCmd.Transform's loop takes `item.GetReplacement(rng)`, calls `item.Original.RemoveFromCurrentPile()` (CardCmd.cs:400) and adds the replacement (CardCmd.cs:437/440); the word Enchantment does not appear anywhere in the method, and neither AfterTransformedFrom nor AfterTransformedTo (CardModel.cs:1625-1631, both empty virtuals -- SovereignBlade is the only override in the source) moves it. So the enchantment dies with the original. SIM: run.transform_card (run.py:725-801) and CardCmd.transform_to_random (cmds.py:1467-1538) both build the replacement with `make_card(...)`, which carries no enchantment. EXECUTED, this unit: `py -c "import sys,random;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from sts2_rl.run import RunState;from sts2_rl.cards import make_card;from sts2_rl.enchantments import make_enchantment;r=RunState(rng=random.Random(0));c=make_card('defend');r.deck=[c];e=make_enchantment('goopy');e.amount=2;e.attach(c);n=r.transform_card(c,into=make_card('bash'));print(n.id, n.enchantment)"` -> `bash None`, matching C#. The in-combat twin (CardCmd.transform_to_random on a Sharp'd Strike) also prints a replacement with `enchantment=None`. Same result for all 17 ids. COVERAGE TABLE for this unit -- (1) ENCHANT: the CanEnchantCardType hook entry plus the reachability guard above. (2) UPGRADE / DOWNGRADE: settled in this record's own creature_card_cmds step-52 entry (this enchantment's attach() mutates a STATIC card property, so a card rebuild can drop it). (3) TRANSFORM: this entry, faithful. (4) COPY: guard EG2, gap. All four verbs are now on the record; before this pass transform and copy were 0/17.

guards.what: EG2: card COPY drops the enchantment. C# CardModel.CreateClone (CardModel.cs:2168) -> MutableClone -> DeepCloneFields re-attaches the source card's enchantment onto the copy -- CardModel.cs:1204-1209 `(EnchantmentModel)Enchantment.ClonePreservingMutability()`, `Enchantment = null`, `EnchantInternal(clone, clone.Amount)` -- and does the same for the Affliction two lines down (1210-1215). The sim's copy sites rebuild the card from its class and carry only the upgrade level.
guards.rationale: Both halves of the entry are closed. The copy carries a live enchantment copy (cards/base.py:77-78 porting CardModel.cs:1204-1209), and `_enter_combat` now registers that enchantment and gives it `combat` (cmds.py:588-591), which is the standing state C# gets from CombatState.cs:462-465 re-enumerating the piles each dispatch. The recorded residual - 'the growth leg is on_card_played, a HOOK the copy's enchantment never receives' - is empirically gone: the copy's Amount goes 2 -> 3 on its own play, matching Goopy.cs:36. The static Exhaust keyword and the Amount-1 block bonus were already riding along and still do (block 6 on a Defend with Amount 2, Goopy.cs:44-47).  RECONCILED 2026-07-28 (Task 0, ledger-vs-code pass after the Tier 1 fix campaign): this entry was recorded `gap` against pre-campaign code and the divergence is closed today. The issue it replaced read: Closed 2026-07-28: all five rebuild copy sites now route through `create_clone` (cards/base.py:57-83), which rebuilds the card AND re-attaches a `clone_preserving_mutability()` copy of the source's enchantment (enchantments.py:109-117 + attach at :119-125) and a copy of its affliction -- the port of CardModel.DeepCloneFields (CardModel.cs:1204-1215). The five: cards/trash_heap_cards.py:20-24 `_clone` (Dual Wield), powers.py:883-893 (JugglingPower), relics/music_box.py:44-49, cards/anger.py:36-38 and relics/burning_sticks.py:33-37. WAS: each was a bare `type(card)()` rebuild carrying only the upgrade level, so the copy lost the enchantment entirely. The false `_clone` docstring is fixed too (trash_heap_cards.py:20-23 now says it carries the enchantment and the affliction, and it does). The enchantment now RIDES ALONG on the copy and every DIRECT-CALL leg works (DamageCmd/BlockCmd read `card.enchantment` straight off the card, cmds.py:115-118 and :219-222; `attach` re-runs modify_card so static keywords/cost are on the copy). What REMAINS is that the copy's enchantment is never made a LISTENER: CardPileCmd._enter_combat (cmds.py:569-576) registers only the card, not `card.enchantment`, and never sets `enchantment.combat`. C# has no such step -- CombatState.IterateHookListeners re-enumerates from the piles on every dispatch and adds `cardModel.Enchantment` (CombatState.cs:449-467, the add at :462-465) -- so the game's copy is a full listener. RESIDUAL FOR THIS UNIT: the Exhaust keyword and the block bonus at clone time both ride along now (executed 2026-07-28: a `create_clone` copy of a Goopy(2) Defend has exhausts=True and gains 6 block = 5 + (Amount-1)), but the growth leg is `on_card_played` (enchantments.py:349-352), a HOOK the copy's enchantment never receives.
